title: Converge logistics acting context
goal: Make mounted admin logistics clients and APIs honor the selected organization, cancel stale work, and harden legacy organization boundaries.

in: Mounted admin logistics data hooks and panels for logistics items, transport, travel, lodging, rentals, metrics, and alerts
Selected-organization request headers, readiness gating, request cancellation, and stale-response discard
Explicit acting-organization constraints for the corresponding admin API routes where active schema ownership is available
Focused client and route contract tests for acting context and cross-organization denial
out: Site-map hooks, components, routes, tests, and ADMIN-003 implementation files
Logistics page navigation, Overview UI, and the new overview aggregate API
Supabase migrations and archived schema promotion

acceptance_criteria: Mounted logistics requests do not fire before a selected organization account is ready
Mounted logistics reads and mutations carry selected profile, account type, organization, correlation, and included-credentials request context
Changing acting organizations clears prior organization state, aborts in-flight work, and discards stale responses
Travel, lodging, rental, metric, and alert API reads cannot return records outside the acting organization
Mutations validate record or parent ownership against the acting organization before writing
Focused tests cover readiness gating, acting headers, stale response handling, and cross-organization boundaries

commands: npx eslint <touched implementation and test files>
evidence: __tests__/admin/admin-acting-request.test.tsx covers unresolved organization readiness, acting headers, FormData, organization switching, aborts, and stale response discard.
__tests__/logistics/logistics-route-contract.test.ts verifies active parent-scope contracts for travel, lodging, and rentals.
Focused Vitest run passed 63 tests before the final readiness and Comms additions; final rerun is tracked in QA-007.

progress.summary: Mounted Logistics requests now wait for a canonical organization, carry acting context, discard stale responses, and use active-schema parent authorization.
completed: Read the admin charter/state, development workflow, builder methodology, and current mounted Logistics request paths
Confirmed ADMIN-003 owns the shared acting-request helper and all site-map files; those files remain untouched
Adopted the acting-request path across mounted logistics, travel, lodging, rentals, transport, production, Comms, and map collaboration clients.
Required a resolved x-acting-org-id before any admin logistics request can fire.
Hardened travel, lodging, and rental APIs with logistics capabilities and event/tour parent validation.
Added stale-response and organization-switch coverage; focused suite passes.
next_steps: Run authenticated browser organization-switch regression when a test session is available.

checkpoints.summary: Converted the skeletal task into a bounded implementation packet after tracing the mounted Logistics clients and APIs.
checkpoints.next: Implement request-context convergence without editing the parent-owned Logistics page or ADMIN-003 site-map files.

checkpoints.summary: Completed acting-context convergence and active-schema boundary hardening. Focused tests and lint pass.
checkpoints.next: Use QA-007 for the authenticated cross-organization browser pass.
